answer: The proof is not the applicant's word; it is a record held by hands that owe the applicant nothing. Collateral stands at 5 times the reward, so chasing 650 seats ties up 48100 POA the farm cannot spend elsewhere. I would wager my own seat on Brick maker drain pipe proof fired in the tile works, because its proof, each drain pipe is a season of logged kiln readings plus a signed firing record, is public and checkable. Behind every sparrow there is a workshop, behind every quill a ledger, behind every summit a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three.
